clearfrom.description: Path to file containing clear-text passwords to encrypt. If empty, defaults to /dev/null (no input file).

chars.description: Generate passwords with exactly N characters.

count.description: Produce a total of N passwords.

crypt.description: Produce encrypted passwords using crypt(). Mutually exclusive with crypt_md5.

crypt_md5.description: Produce encrypted passwords using MD5 digest. Mutually exclusive with crypt.

crypt_salt.description: Use crypt() salt N (0-4096). 0 for random seed.

nocrypt.description: Do not encrypt generated passwords. If true, crypt and crypt_md5 should be false.

random_seed.description: Random number seed N (0-2^32). 0 for true random.

rerandom.description: Set random seed every N values. 0 for single seed.

repeat_pass.description: Use each password N times. Requires crypt=true.

string.description: Character set STRING to use for password generation. Empty for default.
